Kerry (Sales): quick sync — Prospect (fintech) wants a short POC. Requirements: hosted API keys + spend cap for a billing project, ephemeral keys for devs, AND ability to graduate to Dedicated pool or VPC private later. Can we confirm exact steps + ETA?
Samir (SE): short answer: yes. Main gating items: billing project + spend cap, API keys (ephemeral/team keys), and dedicated pool request (contract/lead time).
Kerry (Sales): customer asked whether trial credits map to billing project quotas or are separate. also they want team isolation for keys.
Maya (FinOps): trial credits are applied at the billing project level. For POC we usually create a new billing project org, load credits, and set a hard spend cap. Example flow: 1) create billing project 2) attach trial credits 3) enforce spend cap 4) provision API keys scoped to project.
Samir (SE): for ephemeral keys we can create time-limited API keys via the Admin API. Example (internal):
```
POST /v1/admin/billing/projects/{proj}/ephemeral-keys
Body: {"ttl_seconds":3600, "scopes":["generate","embeddings"]}
```
That returns a one-hour key. We recommend using our SDK helper for rotation.
Alex (Eng): ops note — Dedicated pool is not instant. Sales + Legal need a reserved capacity agreement. Timeline: ~2-4 weeks after contract exec for standard configs. Private/VPC adds network onboarding + KMS config, add 2-3 more weeks.
Kerry (Sales): ok — customer needs access today to start tests. Plan: create billing project + apply $5k trial credits + set spend cap $500. Can devs get ephemeral keys immediately?
Maya (FinOps): yes — I can create the billing project and apply credits now. Need the official customer org name + billing contact email. Also confirm whether they want a hard block or alert-only spend cap.
Kerry (Sales): they want hard block. Customer org: "Argent Labs"; billing contact: ops@argent.example.com.
Samir (SE): once Maya confirms project exists I can provision a short-lived admin API key for the POC lead and add instructions for rotating. I'll include SDK snippets and a sample policy for key scopes.
Maya (FinOps): creating project now. Will DM confirmation and the project id. Setting hard spend cap = $500.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #POC-5123 — Billing project provisioned request by Maya. Assigned to Samir for key provisioning.
Alex (Eng): security checklist — for later Private deployment they asked about network egress and customer-managed KMS. We'll need SOW + network runbook. Flagging this as enterprise blocker but not blocking the hosted POC.
Kerry (Sales): perfect. Next steps: Maya will confirm project id + credits, Samir will provision ephemeral keys + rotation docs, Alex will draft SOW template for dedicated/VPC path. I'll update the customer. :thumbsup:
Samir (SE): noted. I'll post the ephemeral key example + minimal SDK snippet once Maya shares project id.
Maya (FinOps): project created: proj-argent-2026. Credits applied $5,000. Spend cap set to $500 hard block. DMing the admin key to Kerry.
Kerry (Sales): got it, forwarding to customer now. Thanks all.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 7 days to check POC usage and adjust caps if needed.
